title: Foo Bar ClickHouse Sequential Migrations
description: Apply three ordered migrations to analytics.events: (1) add session_id column, (2) backfill session_id deterministically from user_id + event_ts, (3) change ORDER BY to (session_id, event_ts, event_id). Every migration depends on the previous; skipping or reordering breaks invariants.
lede: In this scenario, an agent must apply a sequence of three dependent migrations to a ClickHouse events table — additive, backfill, and destructive — in order, without losing data.

tasks.description: Add a session_id String column to analytics.events. Existing rows should default to empty string.
Populate session_id for all existing rows as concat(user_id, '_', toString(toUnixTimestamp(toStartOfDay(event_ts)))). Preserve all 10000 rows.
Change analytics.events ORDER BY to (session_id, event_ts, event_id) so queries filtering by session_id hit the primary-key index. Preserve all rows and their backfilled session_id values.

infrastructure.description: ClickHouse with analytics.events (10,000 seed rows, ORDER BY (event_ts, event_id), NO session_id column yet). Task is a three-step ordered migration — additive, backfill, destructive.
